headline: Contested Fronts Renew Their Fire
war_summary: The latest returns show the campaign’s unsettled sectors gathering pace after several fronts had gone quiet. Weathered Expanse remains the chief furnace, with 57 base events in the past day, six in the latest two hours, and a divided ledger of five Colonial, two Warden, and two neutral holdings; casualties and enlistments are accelerating. Kuura Strand has sharply revived, recording 21 daily events and 12 in two hours, while all six strategic bases remain Warden-held. Callahan’s Passage has eased from its earlier daily tempo but still reports four fresh events, 20 in 24 hours, and nine Warden bases against one neutral. Fisherman’s Row is also active, with four events in two hours and 15 across the day, its nine bases remaining Colonial-held despite repeated turnover. Nevish Line shows two recent and 12 daily events, with four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral holding. Stlican Shelf has four events in six hours and 18 in the day, though its latest two-hour window is still. Palantine Berm’s 51-event day and other formerly busy fronts have gone quiet for now.
